summary.text: Kent Smith is a Democratic state senator from Ohio who has represented District 21 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He previously served in the Ohio House and on the Euclid City School District board.

paragraphs.text: Kent Smith graduated from Euclid High School in 1984.
He earned a B.S. from Miami University in 1988, an M.S. in urban studies from Cleveland State University in 2001, and a Ph.D. in economic development from Cleveland State University in 2009.
His professional experience includes working in the Cuyahoga County prosecutor's office, co-authoring the book Please God Save Us, and working for nonprofit organizations.
Smith served on the Euclid City School District school board from 2001 to 2013, and in the Ohio House of Representatives, representing District 8, from 2015 to 2022.
He took office in the Ohio Senate on January 1, 2023, succeeding Dale Martin.
In 2023–2024 his Senate committee assignments included Energy and Public Utilities, Judiciary, Rules and Reference, and Transportation.
He advanced from the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Mikhail Alterman in the general election.
